findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 Item 3 列出的法律程序為證券集體訴訟（Jewik／Collins 合併案，D. Mass.），未列反壟斷調查或拆分程序。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: On August 8, 2025, Lead Plaintiffs filed a consolidated amended complaint. Like the earlier-filed complaints, the amended complaint purports to assert claims pursuant to Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Exchange Act and Rule 10b-5

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子指出歐盟等主管機關對醫療公司與醫療提供者互動的審查加強，調查可能增加成本；屬產業一般性監管風險，非針對 TMDX 的已知調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Responding to investigations can be time-and resource-consuming and can divert management’s attention from the business.

note: 兩次搜尋（DOJ/FTC/反壟斷；OPTN/HRSA 監管）皆未見針對 TMDX 的政府反壟斷調查或拆分案；搜尋摘要提及 forced-bundling 為證券訴訟指控，非政府反壟斷行動，未取得可逐字原文故不列 finding。
